models.description: Compact dense Liquid model tuned for fast on-device tool use and coding workflows.
qualityEvidence: Estimated against the recent dense Qwen3.5-4B measured at 25.8% on Terminal-Bench 2.1. LFM2.5-2.6B is smaller but matches or exceeds it on the publisher's shared LiveCodeBench, BFCL, ToolSandbox, and agentic benchmarks; the estimate is discounted because Liquid does not position this checkpoint for heavy agentic coding. Quantization fidelity is curated independently from hardware fit.

models.description: Low-active-parameter Liquid MoE optimized for fast local reasoning and tool use.
qualityEvidence: Estimated from recent small-model analogs: Gemma 4 E2B (5.1B total/2.3B active, 0.4%) and E4B (8B total/4.5B active, 1.9%) bracket its 8.3B total/1.5B active architecture, while Qwen3.5-4B provides an upper capability anchor. LFM2.5-8B-A1B has stronger published tool use but substantially weaker SciCode than those peers, so it is placed between the measured Gemma scores. Terminal-Bench Hard is not used as a numerical proxy.

models.description: Extremely compact 1-bit model for machines that cannot fit conventional small-model quantizations.
qualityEvidence: Estimated from its exact Qwen3-8B parent, measured at 2.2% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, then reduced using Bonsai's published coding and tool-use retention relative to that parent. The parent relationship outweighs looser comparisons to newer unrelated 8B models; Bonsai itself has no Terminal-Bench result.
